extracted.intended_audience: general public; nonprofit organizations, potential grantees, researchers tracking philanthropic awards
extracted.subtask_description: A foundation's public grants database page listing awarded grants with recipient, program area, amount, term, award date, and short project descriptions. Useful for transparency, research, and identifying funded organizations/programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public reporting policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide information about our grants directly to the public through our online database and other sources, such as Candid and the International Aid Transparency Initiative. The database below lists grants once they have been reported to and approved by our board of directors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This states the foundation's practice that grants are published only after reporting and board approval, and that multiple public data sources (Candid, IATI) are used for disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant data fields published
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listed grant includes recipient name, program area, purpose ('for' text), status, award amount, term (in months), awarded date, and a short description; many entries include a 'Visit Website' link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on the page: 'Resources Legacy Fund / Environment / for Open Rivers Fund / Active / $2,000,000.00 / Term: 24.0 Months / Awarded: March 16, 2026' plus a descriptive blurb and Visit Website link. These are the standard fields the foundation exposes for each award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program area categorization
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants are categorized by program area labels such as Environment, Gender Equity and Governance, U.S. Democracy, Special Projects, and Racial Justice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program-area tags appear immediately after recipient name (e.g., 'Resources Legacy Fund / Environment'). This signals the primary strategic focus used to classify awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant status labeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry shows a status label (e.g., 'Active').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status is displayed prominently for each grant. The example page uses 'Active' for all shown entries, indicating current/ongoing awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award amount reporting format
rubrics_metrics.description: Award amounts are published with dollar formatting and two decimal places (e.g., '$2,000,000.00').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary values are reported explicitly for each grant, enabling users to see scale of funding (examples range from $1,200,000.00 to $5,000,000.00 on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Award term and dating
rubrics_metrics.description: Award term is reported in months (e.g., 'Term: 24.0 Months') and the awarded date is given (e.g., 'Awarded: March 16, 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duration and award date are provided for timeline transparency; terms include fractional format with one decimal place on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brief project description requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Each grant entry includes a concise descriptive blurb explaining the purpose of the grant and the recipient's work (e.g., purpose of Open Rivers Fund, U.S. Nature Initiative, Trout Unlimited, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Descriptions explain funded activities and objectives and serve as the public-facing explanation of why funds were awarded (examples: restoring rivers, promoting policies, general operating support).

rubrics_metrics.name: Linking to recipient information
rubrics_metrics.description: Where available, entries include a 'Visit Website' link to the recipient or project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to recipient/project websites to allow users to learn more about funded work; not every entry in the list may include the link, but many do.
